"What the official sources say right now" (generated by `tools/pages.py`, function
`wk_facts`). No Week 11 player row was added, no committed value was changed, and no
flag was removed.

### Injury report

- The official page carries the Week 11 report. The panel said the Week 10 report was
  current. That was stale.
- The committed capture is partial (12 of 13 games). No Week 11 row is transcribed or
  added, consistent with the coverage gate (T65) and with F-55 (corrected by T60).
- The Week 10 counts (347 rows, 70 Out, 11 Doubtful, 90 Questionable) were re-derived from
  `data/injuries-wk10-2026.csv` and are unchanged. They are now labelled as the last
  complete report held in the repository, not as the current official report.

## What changed in the repository

1. `tools/pages.py`
   - `leader_line()` names a sole leader only when one club has the best winning
     percentage. Ties are stated as ties. A build-time check fails loudly if tied clubs
     carry different records.
   - `latest_injury_capture()` reads the newest schema-valid injury read from the
     committed manifest (no network). The injury card is generated from it.
   - The panel's tag now reads "standings, schedule and injury page re-read 19 Nov 2026".
     The starter-change card keeps its earlier date and is not claimed as re-read today.
2. `tools/content.py`: flag F-90 (resolved, irregularity), with the official link and this
   record.
3. Regenerated `site/` pages, the root mirror and the console, by the standard pipeline.

## Not verified here

- The starter-change card (Seattle, Cleveland, Arizona, Miami, Baltimore, LA Rams, Green
  Bay) was not re-read today. It keeps its previous date.
- Week 11 injury rows: none are published. The complete Week 11 report is not yet in the
  repository (12 of 13 games on the latest capture).
- Standings are read through the page-fetch tool, not a captured file. The committed
  standings were verified against the same page on 2026-11-18 by an earlier session.

## Reproduce

```
python3 tools/pages.py && python3 tools/sync.py && python3 tools/validate.py
grep -n "tied at" site/index.html
```
